Package com.smu.mtc.runner

Class AdminKeyStore

java.lang.Object
com.smu.mtc.runner.AdminKeyStore
public final class AdminKeyStore extends Object
Loads the Administrator's ML-DSA signing key pair from disk on every run, generating and persisting it once on first run.

This matters specifically because MTC_BuildRunner is a one-shot process invoked repeatedly by a scheduler: MLDSA.AdminKGen() must run at most once ever for a given deployment. If each run generated a fresh key pair instead of reusing the persisted one, the signatures chained across successive states would not verify against a single stable admin public key.

  • Method Details

    • loadOrInit

      public static boolean loadOrInit(MLDSA mldsa, Path skPath, Path pkPath) throws Exception
      Loads the admin key pair from skPath/pkPath into mldsa if both files already exist; otherwise generates a new key pair, loads it into mldsa, and persists it to those paths (creating parent directories as needed) for reuse by future runs.
      Parameters:
      mldsa - the handler to load (or generate) the admin key pair into.
      skPath - path to the admin private key PEM file.
      pkPath - path to the admin public key PEM file.
      Returns:
      true if a new key pair was just generated (first-ever run), false if an existing one was loaded.
      Throws:
      Exception - if key generation, export, or PEM parsing fails.
